svg.title: Measured WASM batch throughput
svg.desc: Node and Chromium. Independent Float64 sample batches compared with repeated prepared single calls, including small-batch regressions and timing-block confidence intervals.
svg.title: Measured WASM batch throughput

ns2:Work.dc:title: Measured WASM batch throughput
ns2:Work.dc:description: Node and Chromium; core and SIMD; Linear and Sigmoid. Ratios above one improve on repeated prepared single calls. Error bars resample timing blocks, not hardware or workload diversity.
